outlet: The Spokesman-Review, Thomas Clouse, "A large data center is proposed for the former papermill in Usk" (2026-09-25)
notes: Merkle Standard (Allrise Capital) discussing up to 225 MW with the PUD for a data center at the former Ponderay Newsprint mill; Rosencrantz quoted against data centers; reports Warren's husband works as a manager at Merkle Standard; retiring PUD Commissioner Curt Knapp and Commissioner Dave Rick quoted on large-load costs.
